clues: This capital city sits near the middle of a small east African land. Its ground is a patchwork of hills, deep valleys, and steep ridges.
Rain here comes in two wet seasons each year, split by two dry ones. In the long dry spell, from June to September, there is often no rain at all.
A German colonial chief picked this spot for his base in 1907. He liked its place in the middle, its views, and how safe it felt.
A plan to take in migrants sent away from Britain made world news here. The plan was dropped in July 2024, after years of fierce debate.
The president of this land lives and works in this city. Most of the top state offices are based here too.
